title: Crystal Bar Crystal Plus Kit Prefilled Kit Bundle
description: Dive into a world of effortlessly satisfying vaping with our unmissable bundle offer on the bestselling SKE Crystal Plus Kit- exclusively at Vapestore! For a limited time, you can grab the dazzling SKE Crystal Plus battery mod for only £7.99, and we’ll sweeten the deal further with a complimentary pack of prefilled pods in your choice of flavour, PLUS an additional battery and pod, absolutely free! About the SKE Crystal Plus Kit: The SKE Crystal Plus pod kit is your compact, easy-to-use and always satisfying, all-day vaping companion. From the creators of the hugely popular SKE Crystal Bar disposables, this colourful, crystal-encased mod is perfect for those who value convenience and performance. It’s fully compatible with SKE Crystal Plus pre-filled pods, available in a range of SKE's signature flavours for a delightful vaping journey that’s kinder to the environment than single-use, all-in-one disposables. The SKE Crystal Plus Mod, with its 400-mAh battery, supports all-day use and is easily rechargeable via the USB-C cable provided. Enjoy straightforward inhale activation without fiddling with buttons or menus. Designed to mimic smoking, the device is ideal for those newly transitioning to vaping and offers a consistent 11W output for a reliable and satisfying experience. The pre-filled SKE Crystal pods cater to Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) enthusiasts, featuring 2ml of 20mg salt nicotine e-liquid for a smooth throat hit and quicker nicotine satisfaction. These replaceable pods make the Crystal Plus a sustainable, mess-free choice in vaping, without compromising on flavour or ease. Customize Your Bundle: Battery Colours: Choose from Aurora Green, Blue, or Red. Pod Flavours: Select from 6 mouth-watering flavours, each prefilled with 2ml of nicotine salt e-liquid at a 20 mg (2%) nicotine strength.Options include Blue Fusion, Cherry Ice, Pink Lemonade, Lemon & Lime and many more! Battery + Pod Combo: Pick a preferred battery colour and matching prefilled pod flavour: Aurora Blue with Kiwi Passion Fruit Guava Aurora Green with Lemon & Lime Blue with Blueberry Raspberry Grey with Blue Fusion Red with Cherry Ice Following the success of the SKE Crystal Bar disposable vapes, SKE introduced this compact, rechargeable alternative with replaceable prefilled nicotine salt pods for a smoother, more satisfying vaping experience. For variety seekers, additional flavours of SKE Crystal Plus Pods are available in two-pod packs. Replacement batteries can also be purchased separately. Each pod offers up to approximately 600 puffs, varying based on draw length and intensity. Don't miss out on this limited-time bundle offer! Elevate your vaping experience with SKE Crystal Plus, only at Vapestore.
